entries.title: I Timothy 3:1
segments: How true is that saying! When a man aspires to be a Presiding-Officer in the Church, he is ambitious for a noble task.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:2
segments: The Presiding-Officer should be a man of blameless character; a faithful husband; living a temperate, discreet, and well-ordered life; hospitable, and a skillful teacher,

entries.title: I Timothy 3:3
segments: not addicted to drink or brawling, but of a forbearing and peaceable disposition, and not a lover of money;

entries.title: I Timothy 3:4
segments: he should be a man who rules his own household well, and whose children are kept under control and are well-behaved.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:5
segments: If a man does not know how to rule his own household, how can he take charge of the Church of God?

entries.title: I Timothy 3:6
segments: The Presiding-Officer should not be a recent convert, that he may not be blinded by pride and fall under the same condemnation as the Devil.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:7
segments: He should also be well spoken of by outsiders, that he may not incur censure and so fall into the snares of the Devil.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:8
segments: So, too, Assistant-Officers should be serious and straightforward men, not given to taking much drink or to questionable money-making,

entries.title: I Timothy 3:9
segments: but men who hold the deep truths of the Faith and have a clear conscience.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:10
segments: They should be tested first, and only appointed to their Office if no objection is raised against them.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:11
segments: It should be the same with the women. They should be serious, not gossips, sober, and trustworthy in all respects.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:12
segments: Assistant-Officers should be faithful husbands, and men who rule their children and their households well.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:13
segments: Those who have filled that post with honour gain for themselves an honorable position, as well as great confidence through the faith that they place in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:14
segments: I am writing this to you, though I hope that I shall come to see you before long;

entries.title: I Timothy 3:15
segments: but in case I should be delayed, I want you to know what your conduct ought to be in the Household of God, which is the Church of the Living God--the pillar and stay of the Truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 3:16
segments: Yes, and confessedly wonderful are the deep truths of our religion; for-- 'He was revealed in our nature, pronounced righteous in spirit, seen by angels, proclaimed among the Gentiles, believed on in the world, taken up into glory.'
